title: Fibre degree of a finite coproduct of copies of the base
statement: Let $p:Z\to U$ be an affine morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme, pqf-def-affine-morphism], let $J$ be a finite set, and let $D_j$ be schemes with maps $i_j:D_j\to Z$ which form a coproduct cofan [def-galois-finite-coproduct]. Suppose each composite $p\circ i_j:D_j\to U$ is an isomorphism. For every point $x\in U$, the scheme-theoretic fibre $Z_x$ [def-pc-scheme-fibre] has $\dim_{\kappa(x)}\Gamma(Z_x,\mathcal O_{Z_x})=|J|$, where $\kappa(x)$ is the residue field [def-weil-residue-field]. This dimension is the fibre degree used in [def-pc-finite-locally-free]. The empty set $J$ is allowed.

source.place: Tag 03SH (section-trace-method), paragraph after Definition 03SE; the ordinary residue-field product-algebra calculation of the number of sheets is written out by G2.

proof.text: Put K = κ(x) and q : Spec K → U the residue-field map. Each i_j followed by p is an isomorphism. Thus s_j = q followed by its inverse, together with the identity of Spec K, is a pullback square over p ∘ i_j. Pullback.lift of s_j followed by i_j and the identity defines a_j : Spec K → Z_x, whose composite with the fibre projection is the identity. This is IsPullback.of_vert_isIso followed by pullback.lift_fst and pullback.lift_snd.

Finite scheme coproducts are universal. Apply FinitaryPreExtensive.isUniversal_finiteCoproducts and IsUniversalColimit.nonempty_isColimit_of_isPullback_right to the squares just constructed. It follows that the a_j form a colimiting cofan for Z_x, and Sigma.desc a is an isomorphism.

The finite-coproduct isomorphism sigmaSpec identifies the coproduct of J copies of Spec K with Spec(∏_J K). Compose it with the inverse of Sigma.desc a. Its composite with Spec of the diagonal algebra map K → ∏_J K equals the fibre projection: cancel Sigma.desc a, use sigmaSpec_comp_Spec_map_algebraMap, and check on each coprojection where both maps are the identity. Apply Scheme.Hom.finrankΓ_eq_of_iso and finrankΓ_SpecMap. The finite product ∏_J K has K-dimension |J|, by Module.finrank_fintype_fun_eq_card. For empty J this is the zero algebra and dimension zero. All these identifications are proved in Lean in the delivered module.

theorem Scheme.Hom.fiberDegree_eq_nat_card_of_split_cofan
    {Z U : Scheme.{u}} (p : Z ⟶ U) [IsAffineHom p]
    {J : Type u} [Finite J] (D : J → Scheme.{u}) (i : ∀ j, D j ⟶ Z)
    (hc : Nonempty (IsColimit (Cofan.mk Z i)))
    (hp : ∀ j, IsIso (i j ≫ p)) (x : U) :
    p.fiberDegree x = Nat.card J
